interpretation.control_nonempty_target_empty: Supports date-specific unavailability; does not establish publication schedule or prove its sole cause
interpretation.both_nonempty: Current access works; original incident cause remains retrospective and unresolved
interpretation.both_empty: Cannot distinguish entitlement, request policy, missing data, or provider issue
interpretation.401_or_403: Check account/service approval and denial origin; no bypass or retry
interpretation.429_or_5xx_or_timeout: Stop at the first transport error and preserve it; provider incident requires independent evidence
